text:
jess: Quick ping — PR <https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8427|#8427> is blocked on the RFC linked below. Need architecture eyes before merge. RFC: https://redwood-internal.example/rfcs/2024/smart-routing-kv-cache

ryan: @jess I'm on it, will do a pass this afternoon. :eyes:

sam: Heads-up: PR changes routing fallback to model-variant-B when latency > 250ms. Need to confirm SLA implications and cost delta.

marta: Proposed merge window: Wed 10:00 PT. Canary for 2h with 5% traffic, fallback to current model if error rate > 1% or latency regresses.

ryan: Leaving inline comments. Two arch questions:
- Is variant-B quantized? (affects perf)
- How does KV cache invalidate on model switch?

jess: variant-B is int8 quantized in the branch, yes. KV cache invalidation handled by router on model-tag change, see code snippet:
```
if model_tag != cache.tag:
    cache.clear_prefixes()
```

arch-team-bot: RFC review requested: https://redwood-internal.example/rfcs/2024/smart-routing-kv-cache — assigned to @ryan and @marta

ryan: Quick note: LGTM for the high-level approach but holding final approval until I get answers to the two comments. If answers are quick, we can still hit Wed window.

marta: I'll prepare canary playbook and rollback steps in the PR. @oncall FYI.

jess: Thanks all — ping me once arch approval done and I'll queue the merge. :thumbsup:
